Chapter 91

Above the lobby, there was silence.

Everyone did not expect that the method that the Jones patriarch in front of him said was to surrender! Although everyone has this idea in their hearts, they hide it in the deepest part of their hearts and dare not say it.

And the person in front of them not only said it openly, but also did it. How could this not make them feel a burst of surprise and surprise. You know, this person in front of him is the commander in chief of the entire northern region and the south. , or the entire alliance, is a high-ranking existence.

Now he is willing to give up his identity and turn to the enemy in front of him. The fortress he is defending now is Jones's old base. Is he really willing to give up this foundation?

Or, what had those people out there already promised Jones? This promise is either to retain his current position, or to go further. In short, it will not make Jones suffer. That's why he is so eager to be enthusiastic, inviting and forcing himself.

Thinking of this, he couldn't help looking at Jones eagerly, hoping that he could give himself a better answer, such as about the treatment after surrender.

"Jones, how dare you betray Lord Commander and the entire alliance. Are you not afraid of the punishment after the alliance?" Baron, the patriarch of the Braga tribe, roared angrily.

"No, this is not betrayal, this is obedience to the destiny, it is God's will, let us take refuge in that army, anyone who dares to disobey God's will will be crushed to pieces by the endless power of God!"

Jones didn't take the anger and scolding of these people seriously, it was just the dying struggle of some prey before they died.

"Now, it's time for everyone to choose. Should we surrender with me, or fight to the death? Against us?"

Hearing Jones' question that directly asked everyone to stand in line, everyone felt uneasy for a while, looked around, and dared not make up their minds whether to surrender or not?

However, Jones had foreseen the scene in front of him, and he had arranged some people in advance to break the deadlock. Sure enough, in the silence, someone broke the deadlock first and responded to Jones' proposal aloud!

"I, Baru, support Lord Jones' decision. Who dares to resist? It's just to make things difficult for me, Baru!" A barbarian man with a fierce face said in a cold tone.

"I, Cole, agree!"

"I agree with Ferreira!"

"I……"

All of a sudden, dozens of voices of approval sounded from the hall, and the situation on the field suddenly developed in favor of Jones. Many people heard that so many people supported the decision to surrender. Those who were a little hesitant and apprehensive suddenly felt relieved, with a certain expression on their faces, and agreed with them together, and joined the ranks of surrender.

In an instant, in the entire hall, out of the original fifteen or sixteen people, eleven or twelve supported Jones' decision to surrender. Only when he knew that he had no other way to choose, that his relationship with Jones was over, and that he was at the end of his life, did he follow Baron and the few people who had no way out to insist on objecting.

But this is irrelevant, just a few people in this area and the power they have? It does not pose any threat to Jones, who has already mastered all the support of the entire defender.

What's more, at this moment, at the banquet, there will be countless dead soldiers ambushing around him. As long as he gives an order, he will be able to swarm up and take the heads of these people to start a new life and situation for himself , make a sacrifice and farewell.

"Since everyone supports my decision, let's open the city and surrender. Now everyone will go back and make preparations, restrain their soldiers, clean up some unstable factors, and use the best situation and performance to welcome our new Master!"

Jones is also very happy. After all, his goal has been achieved, and he will soon be able to use the merits of his more than 4,000 soldiers in the entire city and use them as his further capital to exchange for the new owner A brighter future.

"However, we still have some problems to deal with now, so as not to leave future troubles and cause unnecessary trouble!"

After finishing speaking, he looked at the Diss group who were hiding in the corner, looking around, waiting for an opportunity to escape, and not wanting to be discovered by others.

Everyone followed, and he looked over together, with malicious smiles on the fish's face in his eyes, and he surrounded them one after another, lest they run away, call the soldiers to resist together, and cause unnecessary trouble.

Seeing that the favorable situation was moving closer to him, Jones no longer hid the dead soldiers he was ambushing. With a loud shout, he called the group of dead soldiers to come out, preparing to give his mortal enemy Diss a decent end. , let him die with dignity like a warrior.

Under the siege of dozens of dead soldiers holding weapons and swarming up, Diss and the others, who did not have any weapons or protective armor, were at a disadvantage as soon as they fought, and they were all killed in a short while. Ended his somewhat glorious life.

As for the other patriarchs who had already chosen to surrender, when they saw those few people being directly beaten to death by those dead men, cold sweat dripped down their faces and foreheads, and they couldn't help but wonder if they would have ended up like this if they hadn't chosen to surrender just now ?

"Now that these unstable factors have been cleared away, let's go back to our own camps, reorganize our troops, and force them, the traitors, to surrender! lest they won't see their leader come back for a long time, and cause any trouble."

All the problems have been completed, and most of my goals have been achieved. Now I just need to force those Diss and his subordinates to give up resistance and accept my own recruitment and guarding.

But this can't be done only by his subordinates who have passed through the city wall and suffered heavy losses. It needs the cooperation of the patriarchs in front of them and their subordinates, so patriarch Jones still asked them very kindly.

Jones is still very kind and caring for those who are in need and beneficial to him. Who will let them bring greater benefits to him? What can I lose with some insignificant feelings and face-saving things!

All the patriarchs nodded yes, and patted their chests to assure Jones that after returning home, they immediately recruited soldiers and horses, waited for the order of Patriarch Jones, and went to surround those unstable soldiers together, so that they could understand Patriarch Jones' benevolence and strength as soon as possible. The great thing about thinking about the big picture.

Jones nodded in satisfaction, and then told them to go back and prepare themselves so that they could go with him to receive the soldiers.

After a while, the patriarchs who had returned to their clansmen immediately gathered all the warriors around them, and those from other tribes who were still feeling unsure because their patriarchs had not returned.

Surrounded by the bewildered faces and expressions of those people, pointing at them with gleaming weapons, they all reminded him that those who were allies and comrades-in-arms a moment ago are now their enemies. Well, life and death are facing each other.
